scenario_invariants.A: The published review opportunity is a strictly positive, finite budget, and it is the budget that ends a cycle: probed immediately on both sides of the candidate's own declared boundary, a recorded pending cycle just inside the budget stays pending while one just outside it is driven to a terminal state and published.
scenario_invariants.B: Collector dispatch for an exact head is bounded and idempotent, and every step reads back the durable record production actually published rather than a substituted liveness reading: a first reconcile against an unrecorded head dispatches exactly once and publishes the durable cycle, reconciles observing that record dispatch nothing further, a durable record whose collector produced no run and that exceeds the liveness grace recovers exactly one further dispatch, that recovery refreshes the durable record so later reconciles consume it, and a cycle whose real accumulated runs have spent the dispatch budget stays pending rather than dispatching without end.
scenario_invariants.G: A WAITING_FOR_REVIEWER exact-head cycle classifies to pending end-to-end through the real resolution path for absent and in-progress cycle evidence, and malformed cycle evidence fails closed rather than classifying as pending.
